name: OpenBlast v1.0.9
highlights: [Vivo OriginOS] [Beta] Center punch-hole status bar capsule (Origin Island) & Origin Player widget registration
[Android] [Beta] Direct Wi-Fi only / mobile data toggle switch with instant real-time download execution
[Desktop] [New] Universal 48kHz audio resampler & movie soundtrack discovery
[Desktop] [New] Full offline download engine, Downloaded library shelf & floating always-on-top Mini-Player
[Web] Fluid mesh player backdrops, Electric Violet & Sunset Coral themes, and expanded controls
[Android TV] 10-foot landscape Leanback experience with D-pad navigation and background playback
[iOS] Early SwiftUI preview build with AltStore/SideStore sideload support and OpenBlast branding
